page.overview:
What is Fifth Member Exclusive Deluxe Box Set Sampler?

It is available for [https://metallica.com/store/9282/kill-ride-deluxe-edition-14-track-sampler free download] for registered members of the Metallica website.

It is a promo release from the Kill 'Em All and Ride the Lightning deluxe box-sets.

Tracks 13 and 14 are not included in the box-set. The box-set does include rough mixes for both tracks, but those are instrumental and lack lead guitar.
